changes.comment: BREAKING: Review: Automatic inbound received/in-progress reactions are removed and replaced by Feishu COT conversation cards. The RECEIVED_REACTION_EMOJI and IN_PROGRESS_REACTION_EMOJI exports, FeishuBot.removeReaction method, FeishuChannelSession.state field, and FeishuChannelState type are removed: stop importing the constants; callers must stop calling FeishuBot.removeReaction; fresh object-literal implementations must omit it, while class implementations should drop the now-unused method; readers must stop accessing session.state or naming FeishuChannelState. The model-facing react tool and addReaction surface remain available. Team-member turn events are ignored by Feishu COT rendering. No rebuild is needed.
